verdict.rationale: Reflect's API uses OAuth 2 with PKCE and user-created client credentials. Its published OpenAPI spec defines two scopes, read:graph and write:graph, so an agent can be given read-only access instead of full write access. That separation is coarse: only two graph-wide scopes are documented, and nothing describes per-note or per-resource restriction, agent-specific tokens, or credential lifecycle controls. Missing for 10: finer-grained or resource-level scopes, documented token expiry/revocation management, agent-oriented credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
